settings.question: Do you really move just one item?
settings.answer: Yes. Single items are our speciality, with no minimum job size.

settings.question: How much does it cost to move one item in Sydney?
settings.answer: It depends on the item, stairs or lift at each end, the distance and timing. We give a fixed price before you book.

settings.question: Can you move it today?
settings.answer: Often, yes. Call or send your request early and we'll confirm same-day availability.

settings.question: Will you carry it inside?
settings.answer: Yes. We carry your item inside and place it in the room you choose.

settings.question: Can you collect an item I bought online or on Marketplace?
settings.answer: Yes. Send us the seller's or store's suburb and we'll arrange the pickup.

settings.question: Is my item insured?
settings.answer: Yes. It's covered while it's in our care, wrapped in blankets and strapped in the van.

settings.local_heading: Why Most Removalists Don't Want Your One Item. And Why We Do.
settings.local_body:
Many removalists have a minimum booking of several hours, so moving one couch can cost as much as a small move. We built Titan Express around single items and small jobs, so one piece gets a fair, fixed price.

Send us the item, both suburbs and any stairs, and we'll come back with a price fast.
settings.step_1_text: Pickup and delivery suburbs, what you're moving, and any stairs or lift. About a minute.
settings.step_2_text: We reply fast with a fixed price and the earliest time we can be there.
settings.step_3_text: Wrapped, strapped and placed in the room you choose.
